F7 is finished and the block "### VERIFY REQUEST — F7 — research default + router stress" is appended to /c/Users/mariu/neural-mesh/results/research_board.md. src/ is untouched. I did not rerun the library tests, and both bins build with at most one harmless warning. Both bins are deterministic: two runs match except `runtime_s`.

Rerun commands (all in the board block, with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=C:/Users/mariu/nm-target-hr):
- `cargo run --release --offline --bin f7_stress -- --out results/f7_stress.json` takes about 3 s; add `--held 61-90` for the confirmation run.
- `cargo run --release --offline --bin f7_research -- --out results/f7_research.json` takes about 30 s including tuning; add `--held 61-90` for the confirmation run.

**(A) Recommended ResearchConfig default** (14 worlds: e3's 7, plus 7 new `cal-*` worlds with a generator self-confidence signal)
- **On:** retrieval, reuse, the e1 guarded(hebr) safe router (tau .7, z .5, kw 4/1, discount .98, challenge), health benching, `store_min` .65, `sim_min` .55.
- **Off:** the critic. The confidence-triggered critic is opt-in only. It is not in the library; I implemented it in the bin as a post-step around `run_task`.
- **Vs plain routing (31-60 | 61-90):** every treatment world is a Holm win. H2000 gains run from +.106 to +.219; the biggest is `cal-rho0.20` on 61-90. The pipeline ties plain in the no-error `control-equal` world.
- **Ablations:** reuse is the largest part (up to +.078 over retrieval-only) and retrieval second (+.013 to +.123 over reuse-only). Retrieval adds exactly 0.000 when notes are useless.
- **Guarded(safe) vs warm(hebr) inside the pipeline:** late quality is a tie. The benefit is early: Holm wins at H250 in 3 of 14 worlds on 31-60 and 6 of 14 on 61-90. The one late Holm loss is diluted-embedding, -.028 on 31-60.
- **Unconditional critic:** net-negative. It is a Holm loss at call cost .03 in 13 of 14 worlds on 31-60 and 14 of 14 on 61-90, including the no-error control (-.003).
- **Confidence-triggered critic** (threshold .3, or an online-calibrated version that learns from delayed grades):
  - Net gain at cost .03 is +.002 to +.018 where confidence AUROC is .82 or higher (and still some at .70).
  - It is about 0 or negative at AUROC .5.
  - It is negative at cost .10 except with near-perfect confidence.
  - Even a perfect oracle trigger is worth only about +.024.
  - The fixed threshold costs -.0017 in the no-error control. The calibrated version makes 0 extra calls there and ties.
  - Conditions to enable it: cost at most about .03, AUROC at least about .8, and a non-trivial bad-draft rate.
  - Caveat: I find small positive nets near AUROC .70 where f4 found none, which is model-dependent.

**(B) Router stress** (e1's frozen default on 13 worlds that were not used for tuning, 31-60 | 61-90)
- **vs keyword:** 36 W / 6 L | 38 W / 7 L, Holm over 52 tests.
  - Every loss is in an honest-keyword world (`pool32-correct`, `ref-correct-keywords`), at most about -.009.
  - The other 11 worlds have zero losses, so "never Holm-worse than keyword" is not preserved. e1's same cells were only Holm-ns because its family had 180 tests.
  - Big H2000 wins: churn-both +.156, bursty-drift +.156 | +.140, gradual-drift +.144 | +.136, abrupt-drift +.109 | +.114.
  - d5's noisy+failing world is a win from H250 up (+.064 at H2000).
  - My copy of e1's generators reproduces e1's published table.
- **vs warm(hebr):** 26 W / 3 L | 28 W / 3 L. The losses are all late, at H2000: abrupt-drift -.017, bursty-drift -.02 | -.013, noisy+failing -.007 | -.011. SAFE wins early.
- **vs guarded-x1:** 7 W / 5 L | 9 W / 4 L. SAFE is better late in drift and noise, but worse in the 32-agent pool (-.004 to -.010).

Negatives are listed in the board block. The main ones: guarded(safe) trails warm by .7-2 points late in drift and noise worlds, and the library defaults (`GuardParams::default()`, `ResearchConfig`) still differ from the recommendation. All worlds are my own synthetic constructions.
